name: Yoshinaga Sayuri ga Yattekuru Yaa! Yaa! Yaa!
original_name: 吉永サユリがやって来る ヤァ！ヤァ！ヤァ！
source:
Teacher instructs the class that at summer vacation textbooks are prohibited and only erotic journals are ok to read. And then he visits students at various locations to check if they follow instructions properly.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-october-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
老师向全班宣布，暑假期间禁止阅读教科书，只能阅读色情杂志。之后，他会到各个地方拜访学生，检查他们有没有认真遵守指示。
